summary: Mr. Harari discusses the minhagim for reading the combined Parashiyot of Behar and Bechukotai, including the selection of maqam and the reading of the Tochachot. He also explains the custom of reciting specific pesukim from Mishle and Yermiyahu before the Tochachot to provide comfort to the kahal.
questions: Which maqam is used when Behar and Bechukotai are read together?
Why is the tone lowered during the reading of the Tochachot?
What is the custom of the Musta'arabi community before the Tochachot aliyah?
How do we avoid starting the Tochachot aliyah with a negative verse?
